extracted.intended_audience: local and national newsrooms, newsroom editors, freelance reporters and photojournalists who want to collaborate with ProPublica
extracted.subtask_description: Practical guidance from ProPublica about the ways journalists and newsrooms can work with the nonprofit investigative newsroom, including joining reporting networks, pitching stories (written and visual), republishing content, and participating in collaborative data projects and tools.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply to be part of our Local Reporting Network
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply to be part of our Local Reporting Network.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Our network pays the salary and benefits of reporters across the country to work on a yearlong investigative project. We help edit the projects and co-publish the work. We have staff to help with certain data, research, engagement, design, and audience development needs. Applications open multiple times per year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report local stories that build on our national investigations
rubrics_metrics.description: Report local stories that build on our national investigations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We provide data, reporting recipes and other resources to help newsrooms localize our reporting on a wide array of issues, from health care and schools to public housing and environmental issues. Check out our data store and news applications for ideas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pitch us a freelance story
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pitches are evaluated on a case-by-case basis; you can submit pitches via the provided submission link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pitch us a visual story
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We review photo pitches on a rolling basis; you can submit your visual/photography pitches via the provided submission link.

rubrics_metrics.name: Republish our stories under Creative Commons
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Many of our stories are published under Creative Commons, meaning you can republish them on your site for free. Follow ProPublica's republishing guidelines (link provided) for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stay up to date on our reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Stay up to date on our reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sign up for ProPublica's daily email updates to receive the latest stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use our collaborative reporting tool (Collaborate)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Collaborate tool allows you to work with other journalists using a shared set of data. ProPublica also provides a guidebook to collaborative data reporting and invites others to help contribute to it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Join one of our collaborative data projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Join one of our collaborative data projects if you work in a local newsroom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Joining gives access to tips and resources on specific topics. Note: currently there are no active collaborative projects. Past projects include Documenting Hate (ran through end of 2019) and Electionland (2016, 2018, 2020), which tracked hate incidents and monitored voting problems and disinformation.
